verdict.rationale: Pipedream's REST API overview says it can be used to create workflows, and the API is published as a machine-readable OpenAPI spec that an agent could consume, so programmatic workflow creation is documented first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows updating or activating/deactivating a workflow through the API; the CLI evidence covers event sources, not workflows. missing for 10: documented workflow update endpoint, documented workflow activate/deactivate endpoint, agent-driven or hands-on corroboration of the workflow lifecycle via API

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API

citations.quote: Use the REST API to create workflows, manage event sources, handle subscriptions, and more.
Pipedream publishes its REST API as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.4 document
